blocks.text: PUERTO PRINCESA CITY, Palawan — Finding no sufficient evidence, the City Prosecutor’s Office here recommended the dismissal of murder and other charges against police officers who were involved in a shooting in Barangay Irawan last April 3. This incident resulted in the deaths of two other police officers and a personnel of the Bureau of Corrections (BuCor). The resolution on the case dated October 26 was signed by Prosecutor Carmelina Ceniza-Guevarra. It stated that murder and frustrated charges filed by the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) against Police Staff Sergeants Jonah Balangan, Michael Juan and Joseph Ian Carpio, Police Corporal Renato […]...
